mapper.sql: evidence_id, package_id, document_id, document_version, evidence_type, file_url, file_hash, file_size, source_evidence_id, generated_time, create_time
mapper.insert: insert into oa_sign_file_evidence ( package_id, document_id, document_version, evidence_type, file_url, file_hash, file_size, source_evidence_id, generated_time, create_time ) values ( #{packageId}, #{documentId}, #{documentVersion}, #{evidenceType}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileHash}, #{fileSize}, #{sourceEvidenceId}, #{generatedTime}, sysdate() )
mapper.select: select from oa_sign_file_evidence where package_id = #{packageId} order by document_id, evidence_id
